issues.description: The 'What's Next' section provides the required sentence but fails to include a relative link to the next chapter as specified in the Docusaurus rules.
issues.fix: Append a relative link to the text, e.g., [Advanced Deployment Strategies](../advanced-deployment).

strengths: Perfect adherence to the provided content specification and section ordering.
Excellent technical accuracy in TypeScript, Next.js, and Stripe integration examples.
Correct implementation of MDX admonition syntax and placement as requested in the spec.
High-quality code blocks with appropriate language tags and file titles.
Strong conceptual depth, explaining the 'why' behind architecture planning and webhook usage.
